name: twemoji-heart-color-variant
description: Preset for 100x100 heart emoji color variants, rendered from the twemoji 1f499 (blue heart) SVG with the fill color swapped. Uses resvg (native SVG rasterizer) so margins and anti-aliased edges match a real browser render pixel-for-pixel.

discord.name_rule: Use at least 2 characters, alphanumeric characters, and underscores.
